name: Baba Yaga
crown: Mistress of the hut: Must start in slot 1 and always holds the Crown, which travels with her. If the Crown ever passes to another of your heroes, you lose.
bond: Hut on hen's legs: Your other heroes have -1 Speed (never below 1) and -2 Health. This bond doesn't affect the enemy.
actions: Pestle (1 AP); Skull fire (2 AP); Mortar ride (3 AP)

name: Beowulf
crown: Bare hands: All your heroes' attacks ignore Guard.
bond: Monster-slayer: When any Beast dies, on either side, he gains +1 Attack for the rest of the fight.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Arm-wrench (2 AP, 1/fight); Axe throw (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Blodeuwedd
crown: Shelter of flowers: At upkeep, your other heroes lose their Guard and she gains it, until the next upkeep.
bond: Cymru kin: Your Cymru heroes have +1 Guard.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Oak, broom and meadowsweet (2 AP)

name: Bran the Blessed
crown: Let him who is chief be a bridge: Your heroes' melee attacks can also target the row behind the one they would normally hit.
bond: Cymru kin: +1 Guard for each other Cymru hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Cauldron of rebirth (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Circe
crown: Aiaia: In rounds when you hold the Fate token, every enemy front-rank card is turned into a swine at upkeep and has 0 Attack that round.
bond: Guests of Aiaia: Your other Hellas heroes have +1 Guard.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Hex (2 AP); Transfigure (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Dracula
crown: Vampire court: All your heroes heal 1 whenever their attacks damage a card, or 2 in rounds when you hold the Fate token.
bond: Master: When another of your Gothic heroes dies, he heals 4.
actions: Claw (1 AP); Bite (3 AP); Turn (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Fafnir
crown: Venom: Fafnir's attacks also give 1 Poison.
bond: Andvari's curse: When Fafnir dies, the card that killed him gains 3 Poison (a random enemy hero, if his killer is gone).
actions: Attack (1 AP); Deep breath (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Friar Tuck
crown: Sanctuary: At upkeep, return one of your dead front-rank cards to its slot on 1 health. 2 returns per fight.
bond: Fellowship of the greenwood: +1 Guard for each other Albion hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Ale and bread (2 AP, 2/fight)

name: Grendel
crown: Night raid: At upkeep, deal 2 damage to the enemy front-rank card with the lowest health.
bond: His mother's mere: While a Grendel's Mother on your side lives, he heals 1 at upkeep.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Devour (2 AP)

name: Grendel's Mother
crown: The mere: Your heroes take 2 less damage from Ranged attacks.
bond: A mother's vengeance: When a Grendel on your side dies, she gains +3 Attack and Speed 3 for the rest of the fight.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Drag under (2 AP)

name: Gretel
crown: Witch-hunter: All your heroes deal +2 damage to Beasts, Witches and Slayers.
bond: Märchen kin: +1 health for each other Märchen hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Into the oven (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Guinevere
crown: The Queen's peace: Your heroes start the fight with +1 Health, and enemy attacks that hit several cards hit only their first target.
bond: Queen of Camelot: Your healing effects restore +1 for each Albion hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Queen's mercy (2 AP, 2/fight)

name: Gwydion
crown: Shaper of flesh: Your summoned cards arrive with +2 health and +1 Attack.
bond: Mourning in Gwynedd: Your front-rank cards have +1 Guard for each of your Cymru heroes that has died.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Shape-shift (2 AP, 1/fight); Battle of the trees (2 AP, 3/fight)

name: King Arthur
crown: The Round Table: From round 3 until nightfall, tale and realm no longer matter for your bonds: each of your heroes counts as being from every tale and realm. In rounds 1 and 2 and from nightfall, only normal bonds work. Aspects still count, so a bond needing a Gothic Beast is met by any Beast. This works for penalties as well as bonuses.
bond: Pendragon banner: Your Albion heroes have +1 Guard.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Excalibur (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: King Minos
crown: Athenian tribute: Each time an enemy front-rank card dies, all your heroes heal 1.
bond: Lord of the Labyrinth: Each time an enemy front-rank card dies, each of your Beast heroes heals 3.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Royal decree (2 AP)

name: Koschei the Deathless
crown: Thief of treasures: Your opponent's items cost 1 action point instead of being free.
bond: Rus' kin: +1 health for each other Rus' hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Whirlwind (2 AP)

name: Lancelot
crown: First knight: When he attacks, the enemy Crown also takes 1 damage, at most once a round. No effect against a side with no Crown.
bond: Sworn to the king: Your Albion heroes have +1 Health. While you field a Sovereign and no Healer, Lancelot has +2 Attack.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Champion's charge (2 AP)

name: Little John
crown: Sherwood stands firm: Your Albion heroes have +1 Guard.
bond: Big man of Sherwood: The first attack each round on any of your other Albion heroes hits Little John instead.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Quarterstaff (2 AP)

name: Loki
crown: Shape-shifter: The first time Loki would die, he survives on 1 Health and swaps places with your highest-Health other hero, who becomes the Crown.
bond: Unbound: Once per fight, when Loki dies, he returns two upkeeps later on 3 Health, if his slot is empty, and deals 1 to every enemy card. If he wore the Crown earlier in the fight, he takes it back.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Mistletoe (2 AP, 1/fight); Crown thief (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Maid Marian
crown: Lady of the greenwood: In rounds when you hold the Fate token, all enemy attacks deal half damage, rounded up.
bond: Avenge the greenwood: The first time another of your Albion heroes dies, she gains +2 Attack and +1 Speed for the rest of the fight.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Fair fight (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Medusa
crown: Stony gaze: An enemy hero that hits Medusa with a melee attack loses 1 Speed for the rest of the fight. Each hero can only be slowed this way once.
bond: Gorgon sisters: +1 Guard for each of your Hellas heroes that has died.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Serpent hair (2 AP); Petrify (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Merlin
crown: Raiser of stones: Your front-rank cards have +1 Guard.
bond: Counsel to kings: While any other Albion hero of yours lives, Merlin's Spells deal +1.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Hex (2 AP); Enchanted sleep (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Morgan le Fay
crown: Enchantress: You start the fight with the Fate token (unless the enemy Crown is Renfield). In rounds when you hold it, enemy Bonds don't work.
bond: Sister to the king: While you field King Arthur, her Spells deal +1, but Arthur has -1 Speed and -1 Attack.
actions: Hex (2 AP); Stolen scabbard (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Odysseus
crown: The wooden horse: In round 1, all your cards except Odysseus are hidden from the enemy.
bond: Men of Ithaca: When one of your front-rank slots is empty at upkeep, a Villager fills it. Once per fight for each Hellas hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Nobody (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Perseus
crown: Winged sandals: Your heroes have +1 Guard in rounds you hold the Fate token, and +1 Speed in rounds you don't.
bond: Gorgon's bane: +1 Attack for each Beast on the board, on either side.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Mirrored shield (2 AP, 1/fight); Medusa's head (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Polyphemus
crown: Shepherd of the cave: Your front-rank cards have +2 Health and +1 Guard.
bond: Son of Poseidon: +1 Attack while another Hellas hero of yours lives. While an enemy Trickster is on the board, -1 Attack instead.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Hurl the boulder (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Red Riding Hood
crown: The basket: At upkeep, heal 2 to your most injured card.
bond: Saved from the wolf: While one of your Slayers lives, the first time she would die each fight she survives on 3 Health.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Cake and wine (2 AP, 2/fight)

name: Renfield
crown: The master's servant: You keep the Fate token all fight. If both crowns are Renfield, this cancels out and the token changes hands each round as normal.
bond: Gothic kin: +1 Attack for each other Gothic hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); The master is at hand (2 AP); Betrayal (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Rhiannon
crown: Cannot be caught: The first attack on her each round from a slower card misses.
bond: Cymru kin: +1 Speed for each other Cymru hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); The unhurried pace (2 AP)

name: Robin Hood
crown: No Crown: You have no Crown this fight, and the enemy wins only by killing all your heroes.
bond: Outlaw's Call: Your other Albion heroes have +1 Speed.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Split the Arrow (2 AP)

name: Rumpelstiltskin
crown: Guess my name: You have 3 guesses a fight. Each round, while planning, you may secretly name one enemy hero, but not the same hero two rounds running. If it planned an action, the action is cancelled and it takes 2 damage. If it planned nothing, Rumpelstiltskin takes 1 damage.
bond: Märchen kin: +1 Attack for each other Märchen hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Straw into gold (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: The Sheriff of Nottingham
crown: Taxed: At the start of the fight, take one item at random from your opponent's belt into a third item slot of yours. If they brought no items, nothing happens.
bond: Men of the shire: Your Albion cards have +1 Guard.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Wanted (2 AP); Break their spirit (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: Sigurd
crown: Gram's edge: Sigurd's attacks ignore Guard.
bond: The dragon's heart: When any Beast dies, on either side, Sigurd gains +1 Attack and +1 Speed for the rest of the fight.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Dig the pit (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: St George
crown: The red-cross shield: Each round, the first attack on each of your heroes deals 1 less damage.
bond: The knight's grief: When one of your Beast heroes dies, St George gives up his own Guard for the rest of the fight and adds it to his Attack. When one of your Healers dies, St George's Attack doubles.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Lance Charge (2 AP); Shield Brother (2 AP)

name: The Bride
crown: Unfinished: While you field a Gothic Beast, she has +1 Guard and +1 Attack.
bond: Made for him: While you field a Gothic Beast, she has +1 Speed.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Completion (4 AP, 1/fight)

name: The Creature
crown: Dread: Enemy heroes have -1 Speed (never below 1) and -1 Guard (never below 0).
bond: Abandoned: The first time another of your Gothic heroes dies, he gains +2 Attack. The second time, he gains +2 Attack and +1 Speed.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Rampage (2 AP); The Pyre (5 AP, 1/fight)

name: The Dragon
crown: Wings over Silene: When another of your heroes is about to die, he automatically swaps slots with it and takes the hit, even if it kills him. The saved hero becomes the Crown.
bond: Old enmity: Your heroes deal +1 damage to Slayers.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Fire Breath (2 AP); Tail Sweep (1 AP)

name: The Huntsman
crown: Hunter's mark: Each round, while planning, choose one enemy hero. All your attacks on it deal +1 damage, and if it is a Beast it can't heal that round.
bond: Told by the hearth: +1 Attack for each other Märchen hero you field, up to +2.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Stones in the belly (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: The Little Mermaid
crown: Turning tide: Every enemy bond that gives a number is reversed: +1 Attack becomes -1 Attack, +1 Guard becomes -1 Guard, +1 Speed becomes -1 Speed, +1 to healing becomes -1 to healing, and so on. Bonds without a number work as normal.
bond: Sea foam: When she dies, your other Eventyr heroes heal 3.
actions: Sea magic (1 AP); Saved from the wreck (3 AP, 1/fight)

name: The Minotaur
crown: The Labyrinth: Enemy Ranged attacks can't target your heroes in slots 2 and 3.
bond: Fed on tribute: Each time the Minotaur kills a hero, your other Hellas heroes heal 1.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Growl (2 AP); Gore (3 AP)

name: The Princess
crown: Blessing of Silene: At upkeep, heal 1 to one of your cards, chosen at random.
bond: Royal grace: Her heals restore +1 for each other Albion hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Mend (1 AP); Girdle Leash (1 AP)

name: The Snow Queen
crown: Hard frost: In every round that you hold the Fate token, all enemy cards have -2 Speed (never below 1).
bond: Eventyr kin: +1 Guard for each other Eventyr hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Shard of the mirror (2 AP, 2/fight)

name: The Steadfast Tin Soldier
crown: Steadfast: None of your heroes can be moved, frozen or stopped from acting, and Poison has no effect on them.
bond: Eventyr kin: +1 Attack for each other Eventyr hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Steadfast stand (2 AP)

name: The Wolf
crown: Big teeth: Your heroes' attacks deal +1 damage to injured cards.
bond: Disguise: While another of your Märchen heroes lives, Ranged attacks can't target him.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Shortcut (2 AP); Swallow whole (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Van Helsing
crown: Garlic and the Host: All healing, on both sides, is reduced by 1. No card can come back from death or cheat it: returns, revivals and 'survives on X health' effects don't work.
bond: Crew of Light: +1 Attack for each other Gothic hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Blood transfusion (2 AP)

name: Vasilisa the Wise
crown: Her mother's doll: The first of your heroes to die each fight survives on 2 health instead, and one of your dead front-rank cards returns to its slot on 1 health, if there is one.
bond: Kin of Rus': While another Rus' hero of yours lives, her heals restore +1.
actions: Attack (1 AP); The doll's advice (2 AP, 2/fight)

name: Victor Frankenstein
crown: Galvanism: At the start of each round, you gain 1 extra action point for each of your other heroes still alive.
bond: Spark of life: At upkeep, he and each of your other Gothic heroes heal 2.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Reanimate (2 AP, 1/fight)

name: Zmey Gorynych
crown: Three heads: His attack becomes three separate attacks of 1 damage each, at three random enemy cards anywhere on the board. If there are fewer than three, a card can be hit more than once.
bond: Rus' kin: Each head deals +1 damage for each other Rus' hero you field.
actions: Attack (1 AP); Heads grow back (2 AP, 1/fight)
